requests.user: {"source":"The cache expires entries after 30 minutes, measured from the last successful fetch. Requests made before expiry return the stored value, even if the source has changed in the meantime. The response does not start a new 30-minute period; only a successful fetch does that. Once an entry expires, the next request attempts a fresh fetch. If that fetch succeeds, the service stores the new value and starts a new expiry period. If it fails, the service returns an error rather than the expired value. This behavior matters for the settings page, where an old value could suggest that a recent change had already taken effect. The prototype does not retry the failed fetch in the background. A later request can try again, and a successful attempt will restore the normal cached path. These rules apply to the current prototype and may change after load testing. For now, documentation and support replies should describe the error plainly and avoid promising that a stale value will appear as a fallback.
